name: Juan Antonio Cano Salado
title: Head of Engineering @ Dedge Security
summary: I am a Software Engineer with 14+ years of experience in product development, design and architecture. I design and deliver robust, scalable and secure solutions. I lead the engineering team at Dedge Security. We build the first Web3 Security Posture Management (W3SPM) platform to secure decentralized applications from code to chain. I also pair with AI every day to design, build and review software.
about: I am a highly motivated and self-confident engineer. My experience spans desktop systems in .NET and C++ to cloud-native Web3 platforms. I worked in blockchain security, intellectual property management, smart water and retail. My approach combines solid architecture, technical leadership and DevSecOps culture. I use AI as a development partner, not as a shortcut. It helps me move from an idea to a working tool in days. The edistribucion client is an example: a public Python tool that reads your real electricity use, built with AI as a partner.

experience.description: I lead the engineering team that builds the first ASPM/W3SPM platform for Web3. I am responsible for architecture and continuous delivery. I manage software lifecycle security and engineering excellence.
highlights: The platform provides continuous security from code to chain.
It integrates into developer workflows and CI/CD.
It meets ISO/IEC 27001 and supports institutional digital asset adoption.
The stack is Go, Kubernetes, AWS, Terraform, observability and DevSecOps.

experience.description: I built large-scale computer vision and retail analytics solutions. I focused on scalability and performance.

I shipped products for more than ten years in C#, C++ and .NET. The work focused on native interop, tooling and high-performance systems. I am the author of open source libraries with hundreds of stars.
highlights: The projects are CameraTF, WasmSample, ManagedCrunch, ManagedXZLZMA and PdbRewriter.
I optimized C++ and C# interop and performance.
I led product architecture and technical teams.

education.detail: The program covered software engineering, systems and architecture.

projects.name: edistribucion-client
projects.description: It is an unofficial Python client for the e-distribucion portal. It reads your real hourly electricity use, so you can compare tariffs and cut your bill.

projects.name: CameraTF
projects.description: It is a Xamarin.Android sample for realtime object detection with TensorFlow Lite. It uses SSD MobileNet and native YUV to RGB.

projects.name: WasmSample
projects.description: It is a sample WASM project with Mono.WebAssembly.Sdk. It shows .NET on WebAssembly in the browser.

projects.name: ManagedCrunch
projects.description: It is a managed C# wrapper for crnlib. It compresses textures.

projects.name: innosetup-tool
projects.description: It is a .NET global tool wrapper for Inno Setup 6.2.2. It targets .NET 6.0 and has no dependencies.

projects.name: PdbRewriter
projects.description: It rewrites .NET PDB files. It helps with obfuscation and tooling.

projects.name: ManagedXZLZMA
projects.description: It is a managed wrapper for the XZ LZMA stream decoder.
